item.title: Michael Kors Taps Actress Meng Ziyi as Chinese Brand Ambassador
item.description: Meng will be featured in upcoming campaigns for the brand, as well as engaging in social media collaborations and personal appearances.

item.title: Bape to Open First Canadian Store in Vancouver
item.description: The brand known for its ape logo and camouflage items operates some 150 units globally.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Paul Smith Poised to Bounce Back After a Tough Year and a Company Reboot
item.description: The brand saw sales dip and profits plummet in fiscal 2025, but those trends are set to change following a business restructuring, with new management in place.

item.title: Stetson and The Great Partner on Western-inspired Apparel and Accessories Collection
item.description: The brands are offering a 25-piece collection of romantic and Western-influenced ready-to-wear, along with heritage-style boots, hats and other accessories.

item.title: Independents’ Day: Tootsies’ Owner Norman Lewis on What It Takes to Run a Successful 55-year-old Retailer
item.description: The upscale women's boutique founded by the late Mickey Rosmarin has stores in Houston, Dallas and Atlanta.

item.title: Bloomingdale’s Spring Campaign Celebrates California Love With Surf Shop, Exclusive Collections and Immersive Experiences
item.description: Surf Shop will introduce 16 Bloomingdale's brand launches, including C.Bonz, Le Prunier, RLT, Elisa Johnson and Chan Luu.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Frankie4 Launches ‘Coast’ Sub-brand With ‘Summer-Proof’ Shoe Styles
item.description: The brand has created a lineup of sandals which can withstand sun, salt and sand.

item.title: The Estée Lauder Cos. to Acquire Remaining Shares in Forest Essentials
item.description: The beauty company's history with Forest Essentials runs deep, first making a minority investment in 2008 and increasing its stake to 49 percent in 2020.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Camper Names Abra Designer Abraham Ortuño as Its New Creative Director
item.description: The fall/winter 2027 season will mark Ortuño’s creative debut for Camper and CamperLab.

item.title: SXSW Taps Unless Collective to Create Special Filmmakers Jacket
item.description: The regenerative brand owned by Under Armour will gift 350 jackets to creatives at the upcoming festival.
